notes.title: Visual Novel Fest! Demo v1.2.0 update!
notes.notes:
Hello yuri gamers, electricians and Michiganders!

It's Visual Novel Fest! If you haven't played the Comet Angel demo yet, this is the perfect opportunity. I've made a number of changes to the demo which improve the look and feel of the game, and which better represent the quality you can expect for the full game, which will be releasing on October 28 of this year. Take a look below for the full list of changes.

[list]
[*] Textboxes and panels have been redesigned
[*] Gallery UI has been improved
[*] CGs are more cinematic
[*] Better use of sound effects at a more consistent volume
[*] Puzzle UIs consistently have better contrast with backgrounds
[*] More stars!
[/list]

I hope you enjoy these new changes! Thank you for your patience while I develop the full game. Comet Angel is a passion project that I develop in my spare time away from my day job. I strive to bring you the best quality experience that I can, so unfortunately I cannot release as quickly as other developers. I sincerely appreciate your interest!
